Author: TheKHD5
Name: Bestiary Nav
Description: Click a Bestiary entry to find its capture location or duty. Highlight nearby uncaptured beasts and optionally travel to them with Lifestream and vnavmesh. /bnav opens the Bestiary; /bnav config opens settings.
Changelog:
- Select multiple monster groups and zones for Levelling.
- Retry empty patrols and failed routes without turning Levelling off.
- Keep patrolling groups that partially overlap your target level range.
- Start a fresh patrol locally when already inside the spawn circle.
Full details on GitHub repo:
